description.text: Research direction: Ancient Chinese Fictions and Fiction Criticism, <Dream of the Red Chamber> and Ancient Chinese Fictions, Ancient Chinese Fictions and Culture, Ancient Chinese Drama and Culture, Ancient Chinese Tourism Literature and Culture, Literature of Wei, Jing, Southern and Northern Dynasty, Literature of Tang and Song Dynasty, Literature of Ming and Qing Dynasty, Ancient Chinese Fictions and Society and Literature of Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasty

duration.text: The Literature in Ancient China at Shanghai Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test)Band 6 Undergraduate school transcript Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant
